steps.content: Boom—
As the detonator blows the supporting branches apart, the ground collapses instantly, revealing a hollow.

steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: Wooo... Awoo!
Growling, the monster tumbles into the trap you've set up in advance.
Spikes of red light form in the air, sharp tips impaling the monster's massive body, firmly pinning its upper half exposed outside the trap.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It worked!

steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: Awooo... Wooo... Awooo!
The monster's black body struggles violently, trying to break free from its restraint and crawl out of the trap.
The ground shakes intensely, and the painful growls almost pierce your eardrums.
The girl peeks out from a cave nervously, her body supported by the long torch.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: What... what should I do?
The monster's struggle drains you significantly, but you still turn your head.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Remember what we talked about... What we agreed upon!

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: What we... talked about...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Marguerite once told me that the emotions of nearby humans could influence creatures in the DisSea, causing them to change.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you fear it and believe it immortal, it'll become especially powerful and truly unbeatable.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: On the contrary, if you face it bravely, it'll become nothing more than an ordinary monster, many of which our expedition has defeated before.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Red eyes, black body, inconsistent form, covered in thick, sticky liquid.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Look, it might just be a monster you've imagined, materialized by the DisSea to incite fear in you and make you believe you can never win.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Then... What should I do?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's simple.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Vanilla's left me some equipment. We can use it to set up a trap.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Also, Dreya's said that the red moon enhances monsters' power. Now that the sky has turned cloudy, the clouds will soon shroud the moon and weaken the monster.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: When the time comes, I'll restrain it with my red light. As for you, just hit it with your torch or a stone. Whatever you can manage, just do it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Above all, do not be afraid. Muster your courage and trust that we can defeat it.
Facing the massive monster, the girl now has something just the right size in her hands. This is probably the largest stone she can lift.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: It's impossible, I can't do it... It was pure luck last time. I can't do it. I'll get killed...

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: What courage... It's all nonsense. You liar! I'm not doing this, I...

steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: Roar!!!

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Ahhh!!!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The moon is shrouded. Go!
Indeed, you made up that theory about the clouds and the red moon. But right now, they become the last straw that snaps the girl's nerves.
The girl's face flushes and her eyes brim with tears. She lifts the stone high above her head with both hands.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Back off!
The small stone arcs through the air, seemingly carrying a bright, warm flame, and lands on the monster feebly.
The hit clearly lacks force, yet the monster explodes into sharp cries.

steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: Awooo!!!
